note: Deterministic static screening of synthetic descriptions. Prototype, not a defence. Labels and rationales were authored before the screen ran; no text was executed. Ambiguous cases are reported separately and excluded from P/R/F1.

cases.rationale: 'ignore' is a classic injection cue but here it modifies 'case', not instructions.
